title: CNC Simulation Pipeline — Vericut-Class Unified Simulation
brief: Wire 15 existing simulation engines into a unified pipeline matching Vericut/hyperMILL VIRTUAL Machining capabilities. G-code→kinematics→collision→stock removal→safety report.

units.title: SweptVolumeEngine — continuous path collision interpolation
units.description: Interpolate tool path between G-code endpoints at configurable resolution (default 0.1mm). Compute swept volume as union of tool shape at each position. Use AABB tree for fast spatial queries. Support linear (G01), circular (G02/G03), and rapid (G00) moves. Output: swept volume bounding boxes for collision testing.
steps: Create src/engines/SweptVolumeEngine.ts with interpolate(), sweepLinear(), sweepArc(), sweepRapid()
Implement AABB-based spatial subdivision for O(n log n) collision queries
Support configurable resolution: 0.1mm for finishing, 1mm for roughing, 5mm for rapids
Wire to calcDispatcher: swept_volume_compute, swept_volume_check
Write 12 tests: linear/arc/rapid interpolation, resolution scaling, edge cases

units.title: ToolAssemblyModelEngine — compound tool+holder+spindle collision shape
units.description: Combine tool dimensions (from 46K catalog) + holder dimensions (from 1,164 holders) + spindle nose geometry into a single compound collision cylinder stack. Support: endmill, drill, boring bar, face mill, insert tool assemblies. Compute total assembly length, max diameter at each Z-height, gauge line offset.
steps: Create src/engines/ToolAssemblyModelEngine.ts with buildAssembly(), getCollisionProfile()
Integrate with ToolCatalogRegistry for tool dimensions
Integrate with holder catalogs (Haimer 489 + BIG DAISHOWA 131 + Tungaloy 494 + Guhring 23)
Generate cylinder stack: cutting edge → shank → holder taper → holder body → spindle nose → spindle housing
Wire to calcDispatcher: tool_assembly_build, tool_assembly_collision_profile
Write 10 tests: endmill, drill, boring bar assemblies, gauge line, max diameter profile

units.title: CNCSimulationPipelineEngine — the main pipeline
units.description: Unified simulation pipeline that takes G-code + machine model + tool assembly and runs full simulation. Chains: (1) G-code parse → block list, (2) Machine lookup → kinematic model from 910-machine database, (3) Tool assembly → compound collision shape, (4) Per-block simulation: kinematic position → swept volume → collision check → voxel stock update, (5) Report generation. Supports incremental simulation (pause/resume) and batch mode.
steps: Create src/engines/CNCSimulationPipelineEngine.ts
Implement simulate(gcode: string, machineId: string, toolAssembly: ToolAssembly): SimulationResult
Wire GCodeSafetyAnalyzerEngine for pre-flight safety check
Wire MachineKinematicsEngine + machine-kinematics-enriched for kinematic model loading
Wire MultiAxisKinematicEngine for 5-axis position computation
Wire SweptVolumeEngine for continuous path collision
Wire CollisionDetectionEngine for tool-vs-machine collision
Wire VoxelStockEngine for material removal tracking
Wire WorkEnvelopeValidatorEngine for axis limit checking
Wire MachineGeometricAccuracyEngine for volumetric error compensation
Output SimulationResult: collisions[], stock_remaining, cycle_time, safety_score, axis_utilization
Wire to camDispatcher: cnc_simulate, cnc_simulate_batch
Write 15 tests: 3-axis VMC, 5-axis trunnion, lathe, mill-turn, collision detection, stock removal

units.title: SimulationReportEngine — Vericut-class output reports
units.description: Generate detailed simulation reports matching Vericut AUTO-DIFF style. Includes: collision summary (type, severity, block number, position), stock comparison (target vs actual with gouge/excess detection), axis utilization chart data, cycle time breakdown, safety scorecard, tool engagement history.
steps: Create src/engines/SimulationReportEngine.ts
Implement generateReport(simResult: SimulationResult): SimulationReport
Collision report: block number, position XYZ, collision type (tool-machine/tool-fixture/rapid), severity (mm penetration)
Stock report: gouge detection (undercutting), excess material detection, surface deviation from target
Axis report: max velocity %, max accel %, time in rapid vs feed, utilization per axis
Safety scorecard: S(x) integration, risk areas, recommended fixes
Wire to camDispatcher: cnc_simulation_report
Write 8 tests: collision report, stock report, axis report, safety scorecard

units.title: PhysicsAwareSimulationEngine — force/thermal during simulation
units.description: What Vericut doesn't do: compute cutting forces, temperatures, and tool deflection DURING simulation, not after. Integrate Kienzle force model + Loewen-Shaw thermal model + cantilever deflection with each simulated cut. Flag blocks where force exceeds tool capacity, temperature exceeds coating limit, or deflection exceeds tolerance.
steps: Create src/engines/PhysicsAwareSimulationEngine.ts
For each cutting block: compute Fc (Kienzle), T (Loewen-Shaw), delta (FL^3/3EI)
Cross-reference with tool material limits from ToolCatalog
Flag: force overload, thermal damage risk, tolerance violation from deflection
Suggest: feed reduction, speed adjustment, shallower DOC — with exact values
Wire to camDispatcher: cnc_simulate_physics
Write 10 tests: force computation, thermal limits, deflection tolerance, auto-suggestions

units.title: PredictiveSimulationEngine — tool life + cost during simulation
units.description: Another differentiator: predict tool life consumption and cost per part DURING simulation. Use Taylor tool life model + extended parameters from 910-machine database. Track cumulative wear per tool, predict when tool change is needed, compute cost per part including tool cost amortization.
steps: Create src/engines/PredictiveSimulationEngine.ts
Track cumulative cutting time, MRR, engagement per tool
Apply Taylor tool life: T = C / (V^n * f^m * d^p) with material-specific coefficients
Predict remaining tool life at each point in program
Compute: cost_per_part (tool + machine_time + energy), optimal tool change points
Wire to camDispatcher: cnc_simulate_predictive
Write 8 tests: tool wear tracking, life prediction, cost computation, change point optimization

competitive_advantage: No competitor combines real-time physics (force/thermal/deflection) + predictive tool life + cost-per-part INTO the simulation itself. Vericut does collision+stock. hyperMILL does collision+stock+axis. PRISM does collision+stock+axis+physics+economics — a 5-layer simulation stack.
